description: Look up who connects where on the internet, from PeeringDB's public database of networks, Internet exchanges and data centres. Find a network by name or AS number and read its peering policy, AS-SET, prefix limits and NOC, abuse and peering contacts; list its ports at exchanges with speeds and addresses, and the facilities it is in. Search exchanges, list their members and peering LAN prefixes, find facilities and who is in them, look up the organizations, carriers and campuses behind them, and find whose port an exchange IP address is. No account or API key required.
